prose.subject: Invoice INV-36029 & Updated Payout Details - Kestrel Print
prose.body:
Dear Rafael,

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to provide you with our latest invoice, INV-36029, for the recent print run completed last week. The total amount due is 399.98 USDC. Please find the PDF attached for your records.

Additionally, I wanted to inform you that we have recently added a new payout account to our system. For all future payments, please direct funds to our new address: 0x4c005e6a674e0b282a4097b5d59038b9f793b2e3. We have also linked this new account to our domain (kestrel-print.example) to ensure seamless verification on your end. This change is part of our routine financial updates and should not affect your standard approval processes.

If you have any questions regarding the invoice or the new payment details, please do not hesitate to reach out. We appreciate your continued partnership with Greywater Robotics and look forward to maintaining our smooth collaboration.

Best regards,

Ines Rossi
Accounts Receivable
Kestrel Print
